args: for L in A B; do case $L in A) lab=INSTALL-PINNED;; B) lab=INSTALL-RENAMED;; esac; m=/home/user/factory-builds/d17-kernels/$L/wasm64-unknown-unknown/release/factc_wasm_abi.wasm; want=$(node -e 'const b=JSON.parse(require("fs").readFileSync("evidence/D17/kernel/builds.json"));console.log(b.builds.find(x=>x.label===process.argv[1]).wasm_sha256)' $lab); have=$(sha256sum $m | cut -d' ' -f1); [ "$have" = "$want" ] || { echo "$m: $have != $want"; exit 1; }; echo "$lab $m sha256 == evidence/D17/kernel/builds.json"; node tests/toolchain/proof.mjs kernel-identity --sets tests/toolchain/proof-sets.json --out evidence/D18/kernel --id KRN-D18-$L --root . --module $m || exit 1; grep -q '"verdict": "PASS"' evidence/D18/kernel/KRN-D18-$L.json || exit 1; done
